Findings

{{findings_appendix}}

Method & limitations: competitors are ranked by how many of the {{term_count}} sampled store queries they appear in, then by average position — a single live snapshot taken {{generated_at}}, not a trend. Share of search is unweighted. Category positions are only comparable between apps in the same category; mismatches are flagged above. Rating figures are ratings, not reviews, filtered to {{country}} with one country per request — incremental over the window on the App Store, cumulative on Google Play. An empty category position means the app is not in that country's chart, not that data is still being collected. {{ios_truncation_note}} No install, download or revenue data exists in this pipeline, so nothing here is weighted by acquisition volume.
